title: Radio Control and Monitor
description: Designs bounded low-power radio supervisory boards combining control, monitoring, and external interfaces.

supported: protected power and wired service interfaces

constraints: Keep radio-sensitive regions separated from switching power and noisy external interfaces.
Honor module keep-out, grounding, thermal, and supply-transient guidance.
Expose antenna, enclosure, and regulatory dependencies for human review.
evidence_requirements: Official host-interface and integration documentation for selected radio functions.
Authoritative power, protection, timing, and external-interface documentation.
Applicable module certification conditions and layout restrictions.

verification: ERC and DRC findings are reported without concealment.
Module integration, external ports, and power integrity receive independent review.
RF and regulatory claims not proven by available tools remain open issues.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Provide complete editable artifacts and traceable integration risks; final RF, enclosure, and regulatory approval remains a human responsibility.
